data.title: ONE Championship: Seksan finally yields to Father Time in emotional Lumpinee farewell
data.description: The heavens opened over Lumpinee Stadium. Inside, the tears soon followed.

data.title: Beds too short in 'worst-ever' Asian Games rooms, say South Korea
data.description: TOKYO - Accommodation at the Asian Games starting this week in Japan is the "worst ever", South Korean officials told AFP on Monday, also warning of "a serious shortage" of rooms.

data.title: Zverev holds off Shelton to win US Open title
data.description: NEW YORK - Alexander Zverev held off Ben Shelton to win the US Open on Sunday, capturing the second Grand Slam of his career just months after winning the French Open.

data.title: World championship leader Antonelli wins Spanish GP
data.description: MADRID - Kimi Antonelli extended his lead in the world championship with his eighth victory of the season at the Spanish Formula One Grand Prix at the Madring on Sunday.

data.title: Thais target strong start against Japan
data.description: Thailand's women's football team are determined to put on a good performance against defending champions Japan in the first group game at the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 on Monday, said head coach Natipong Srithong-in.

data.title: Magno's late magic helps Pathum snatch first victory
data.description: BG Pathum United picked up their first win of the season when they defeated Rasisalai United 3-2 in the Thai League 1 on Saturday night.

data.title: Sahasawat soars to PGA title
data.description: Sahasawat Ariyachatvakin claimed his first Thailand PGA Tour title, winning the Singha-SAT Nakhon Ratchasima 2026 on Friday.

data.title: Robinho strikes late as Buriram drop points
data.description: Robinho Junior's second-half goal denied defending champions Buriram United a home victory, while Port picked up their second successive win in the Thai League 1 on Friday night.

data.title: Kop's back as Liverpool fans set to paint Bangkok red for massive run
data.description: Liverpool's Kop Run Bangkok 2026 will take place on Sunday at Plaza Court, Rajamangala National Stadium.

data.title: Hull hold Chelsea, Liverpool fail to beat Fulham in Premier League
data.description: LONDON - Hull held free-scoring Chelsea 2-2 at Stamford Bridge to go third in the Premier League as Liverpool failed to find a way past struggling Fulham in a 0-0 draw on Saturday.

data.title: 'Great to have a race at home': Fans celebrate F1's Madrid return
data.description: MADRID - Forty-five years after Formula 1 last roared around Madrid, the Spanish capital is celebrating its return this weekend with a brand-new circuit, accessible from the city centre via only a metro ride.

data.title: Stunning US fightback sets up Solheim Cup singles showdown
data.description: THE HAGUE - Europe and the United States will head into Sunday's decisive Solheim Cup singles level on points after a breathtaking rearguard action by the Americans in a nail-biting afternoon fourball session.

data.title: ONE Championship: Yod-IQ says Jonathan Haggerty needs Muay Thai win before title shot
data.description: Thailand’s Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri says British rival Jonathan Haggerty should earn a win in Muay Thai before challenging for his newly claimed ONE Championship bantamweight belt – and is serious about going after the Englishman’s kickboxing crown instead.

data.title: One manager gone and more to follow
data.description: Every manager or head coach in the English Football League knows that at some time they will either get the sack or have to hastily resign before they get the sack. The latter is often termed "leaving by mutual consent" although there is nothing remotely "mutual" about it.

data.title: Kingdom's stars determined to excel at SEA team event
data.description: The Thai national golfers intensified their preparations ahead of their participation in the Southeast Asian Amateur Golf Team Championships 2026 next week.

data.title: Thais ready for Games test, says coach
data.description: Natipong Srithong-in has declared Thailand's women's football team ready for the Asian Games, despite a preparation period he admits was far from ideal.

data.title: Duplantis delivers masterclass for Ultimate pole vault win
data.description: BUDAPEST - World and Olympic champion Armand 'Mondo' Duplantis delivered a faultless display of pole vaulting to seal victory on the opening day of the Ultimate Championship in Budapest on Friday.

data.title: 'Desperate' Sabalenka books US Open title clash with Rybakina
data.description: NEW YORK — Aryna Sabalenka stormed past Jessica Pegula in straight sets on Thursday to keep her bid for a rare US Open three-peat on track, booking a championship showdown with Elena Rybakina.

data.title: Manchester derby poses Maresca's first big test, Chelsea aim to end Hull Honeymoon
data.description: MANCHESTER — Enzo Maresca faces his first major test since stepping into Pep Guardiola's shoes as City visit United in the Manchester derby on Sunday, while Arsenal aim to extend their flawless start at Sunderland.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rambolek stripped of title on scale after missing weight
data.description: Thailand’s Rambolek Chor Ajalaboon has lost his ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai world title on the scale after missing weight in Bangkok – leaving Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri as the only man who can claim the vacant belt at The Inner Circle 30.

data.title: Kieran opts out of squad for LA push
data.description: Thai-American distance runner Kieran Tuntivate has spoken of his regret at missing the 20th Asian Games in Japan, revealing he turned down a place in Thailand's athletics squad to focus on his marathon ambitions instead.

data.title: Man United, Bayern cruise as Como make dream Champions League start
data.description: PARIS - Manchester United celebrated their return to the Champions League with a 4-0 thrashing of Sabah on Thursday, as Cesc Fabregas's Como impressed on their debut in Europe's premier club competition.

data.title: Suchai upbeat despite uphill trek in Japan
data.description: Tennis chief Suchai Pornchaisakudom believes that the Asian Games competition will be challenging but remains confident that Thai athletes can pull off a strong showing in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: Thunder Castle begin life under Silva
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United return to Thai League 1 action today, hosting Chiang Rai United at the Chang Arena in new head coach Mario Silva's first match in charge since his appointment this week.

data.title: Indian trailblazer seeks Asian Games weightlifting glory
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian weightlifter Mirabai Chanu says she “will not let go” of the chance to round off a glittering career with an elusive Asian Games medal, saying her goal feels “so close”.

data.title: Rybakina books US Open semi-final against Gauff
data.description: NEW YORK - Elena Rybakina ended Zheng Qinwen’s spirited US Open run on Wednesday, guaranteeing her rise to world No. 1 as she booked a semi-final showdown with Coco Gauff.

data.title: Thais secure two berths for track worlds
data.description: Thailand have booked two places at the UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai next month, after the national sprint team and a lone rider in the men's 1km time trial earned qualification on the back of strong recent form.

data.title: Spikers continue winning run, reach Asian quarters
data.description: Thailand claimed their third straight win in the preliminary phase of the AVC Men's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 in Japan and qualified for the quarter-finals as Pool C winners.

data.title: Buriram pick Silva, Sailors land Jackson
data.description: Buriram United have appointed Mario Silva as head coach, turning to the former Porto youth-team architect to lead the Thai League champions into the 2026-27 season, as his predecessor Mark Jackson resurfaces at Singapore's Lion City Sailors.
